John Ternus, the incoming Apple CEO, will be fronting the September event Historically, the fall is Apple's biggest quarter when it comes to launches. Regular as clockwork, September is known as the time Apple brings out a new generation of iPhones and a bunch of other major products. From Apple's perspective, it's perfect timing. It all happens a short time ahead of the lucrative holiday shopping season, with the sales reflected in its quarterly results. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

items.title: Ternus takeover won't mean a mass Apple exec exodus
items.snippet: An overblown new report claims that Apple has been carefully orchestrating executive retirements for years to not spook shareholders. items.title: Apple Watch Series 12 ceramic case rumors continue with new color claims
items.snippet: The 2026 Apple Watch refresh is, once again, speculated to ship with not one, but two premium ceramic options. That's assuming you can afford them. Apple Watch Series 5, in Ceramic The rumor mill has repeatedly brought up potential changes to the Apple Watch lineup, as well as how it apparently won't change that much. items.title: Don't expect an Apple Pencil for the folding iPhone
items.snippet: "If you see a stylus, they blew it," was a Steve Jobs position on why fingers are the input choice on iPhone. While iPad has Apple Pencil , Apple isn't looking to make one for the iPhone Ultra. iPhone Fold won't ship with a stylus Even though Steve Jobs might have made a point to avoid styluses in 2007, that stance can easily have changed in the intervening 19 years. Nvidia's upcoming DLSS 5 neural rendering tech leaked earlier this week through a pre-release version of the DLL inside NBA 2K27 (which is in early access). The community quickly got it working on RTX 50-series GPUs, some of the best graphics cards, but modders later patched the DLL to work on RTX 40-series GPUs, too. Now, thanks to rapid development in the RenoDX Discord server, the DLL has once again been patched to work on RTX 30-series GPUs. Scouring through the server, the general sentiment is mixed. DLSS 5 works on Ampere cards, but performance tanks in almost every case. Any time a user shows decent framerates, it comes at the cost of base visual fidelity.
